response.text:
ItemID: NA; Title: Blak and Blu; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Blues-rock guitar fits my recent Hendrix and Clapton listening; this is my first pick.
ItemID: NA; Title: Nathaniel Rateliff & The Night Sweats; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy soul sound appeals, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Alligator Records 25th Anniversary Collection; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues fits my interests, but I am not looking for a broad compilation today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Santana IV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Guitar-led rock sounds appealing, but I would stick with my stronger blues picks today.
ItemID: NA; Title: In My Soul; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Robert Cray's soulful blues feels like a natural follow-up to Memphis and Old Sock; I would try this too.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less appealing than blues guitar and vocals right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: In Session; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues guitar collaboration interests me, but I would leave it for a later listen.
ItemID: NA; Title: Days Of Future Passed; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Orchestral progressive rock is not what I feel like hearing today.
ItemID: NA; Title: I Am The Blues; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic blues appeals, but I am leaning toward a more contemporary sound this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Story of Sonny Boy Slim; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This also fits my blues-rock interests, but I would try Blak and Blu before choosing another Gary Clark Jr. album.
